correctness.rationale: The primary source supplies a continuous compactly supported endpoint counterexample with shrinking admissible covers and a harmonic-series divergence. Disjoint translations give an exact p-sum Sobolev norm identity, hence a closed ell_p range. Local finiteness gives continuity. For any nonzero coefficient vector, positive support separation isolates one translated copy on all sufficiently small bad balls, so the same divergent p-sum survives after multiplication by a nonzero scalar. These steps establish all quantifiers for every n>=1 and p>n.
